svg.title: Observing the Dapr sidecar
svg.desc: The Dapr sidecar, drawn as a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo, with three things above it inside a dashed area named "Your platform and tools": Kubernetes on the left, Grafana in the middle and Fluentd on the right. From Kubernetes a line runs down and turns right into the sidecar, labelled "Health checks" and "GET http://localhost:3500/v1.0/healthz". Above the sidecar a dashed card named "Metrics" holds the Prometheus mark and the words "Prometheus endpoint :9090", and an arrow carries on up from it to Grafana. To the right of the sidecar a line runs right and turns up through a dashed card named "Logs", which lists the levels debug, info, warn and error, and on to Fluentd.
